title: 英伟达与谷歌各投 100 亿美元认购 Anthropic IPO，估值直冲 1.4 万亿美元
summary: Anthropic IPO 获英伟达与谷歌各 100 亿美元现金认购、估值区间上沿约 1.4 万亿美元，成为本窗口最热事件。
summary_en: Nvidia and Google are each set to subscribe to Anthropic’s IPO with $10 billion in cash, according to the note, which describes the deal as this window’s hottest event. The reported valuation range could reach as high as $1.4 trillion at its upper end. The note presents these figures and participation plans as stated, without independently confirming their status.
body:
Anthropic IPO 获英伟达与谷歌各 100 亿美元现金认购、估值区间上沿约 1.4 万亿美元，成为本窗口最热事件。

Anthropic
- 英伟达、谷歌各投 100 亿美元，按 IPO 价格认购 Anthropic 股票 — 芯片巨头与云巨头用现金为 Anthropic 估值背书，上市估值区间上沿约 1.4 万亿美元
  https://www.tokenpost.com/news/business/55198

  https://www.qbitai.com/2026/11/509291.html

OpenAI
- OpenAI 联合发布支持 AI 与儿童安全研究的声明与资助计划 — 在监管收紧期主动设置儿童安全议程，争夺安全治理话语权（11 月 12 日 08:00 北京时间）
  https://openai.com/index/children-first-declaration

Google（含 DeepMind）
- Gemini 应用上线 Apple CarPlay，可在车内语音对话 — 把 Gemini 塞进车载高频入口，消费端分发竞争升级（11 月 12 日 01:00 北京时间）
  https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/gemini-on-apple-carplay

xAI

DeepSeek
